text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Long time no see, Nakayama. What business 
does a goody two-shoes who ran back to 
Tracen have with us?"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Just a little test of skill. ...You'll 
run, won't you?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Heh, you're on. Let's run... 2400 meters, 
just like last time!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Keeping up with my pace, huh...! Well, 
you'll burn out soon enough anyway!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(I see right through your plan...! Making 
it look like you're rushing, just to—)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna tear you all to shreds!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa, haa...! How the hell does she 
still have a burst at the end... Damn it!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Every day is a battlefield for me. I 
can't just stay the way I used to be.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hah, guess you're not getting rusty after 
all. ...If anything, you've built up quite 
a bit of stamina.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Well, I'm a "good kid," after all. I 
followed my Trainer's guidance to a T.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I went to the track, Nakayama Festa 
had already started training.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Your way of doing things isn't bad.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps she could feel her own growth 
firsthand. It seemed Nakayama Festa had 
come to acknowledge all the training up to 
this point!
